label: Notification badge
intent: A new notification arrives: the badge springs out of the app tile. Light: the badge ducks into the tile's corner, shrinking, then springs back out to its spot and pops past full size before it settles; the tile recoils as the badge launches. Strong: a deeper duck, a bigger pop with two rebounds, a second ping, and the tile recoils harder and rocks to rest.

tile.//: the app tile recoils about its centre as the badge launches off its corner

badge.//: the badge pops about its own centre
